## What Trans-Fil does

Trans-Fil designs, manufactures and maintains specialized industrial machinery for the steel, automotive, oil & gas and machine-tool sectors. Each unit is engineered around the actual production process and integrates with the existing line flow.

Four product lines:

### T01 — Chip transport (Transporte de viruta)

Evacuation systems for metal chips, parts and waste from production lines, machining cells, transfer lines and CNC centers. Configurable as hinge, scraper, magnetic, belt, plastic chain or combined.

Bullets:

1. **Chip transport / Transporte de viruta** — Transport systems for every type of chip and for both stand-alone and large-scale machining processes. Configurable as hinge, scraper, belt or plastic chain depending on material and flow rate. Heavy-duty build for 24/7 continuous operation.
2. **Continuous drying lines / Líneas de secado continuo** — Special conveyor belts with micro-perforated links separate solid and liquid parts during drying, guaranteeing the moisture reduction required by waste-treatment and parts-treatment processes.
3. **Centralized lines / Líneas centralizadas** — Multi-machine systems that evacuate chips from a whole shop floor to a single discharge point. Dozens of machine tools share a single transport circuit, eliminating manual handling between stations. Frees up staff and cuts cleanup downtime.
4. **Custom design / Diseño a medida** — Geometry, width, height, speeds and other features designed and adapted to each process and layout. Each unit is sized from the on-site assessment and validated with a 3D drawing before manufacturing. Materials and components selected according to chip type and coolant.

### T02 — Industrial washing (Lavado industrial)

Automatic washers for machined parts, casting and forging. From single cells to continuous lines with drying and air-knife.

Bullets:

1. **Pass-through & rotary / Pasante y rotativas** — Continuous pass-through cabins with belt or rotary table for serial production. Configurable cycle: wash, rinse, dry. Integrates into the existing line, synchronizing load, unload and bath temperature with the plant's rhythm.
2. **Single-cabin washer / Lavadora de cabina individual** — Multi-purpose washing systems for manual loading and unloading. Suited to parts with varied geometry and small batches where a continuous line isn't justified. Programs selectable from the HMI.
3. **Built-in filtration / Filtración integrada** — Belt filters, cyclones and oil skimmers that keep the bath clean and extend fluid life. Cuts detergent-change frequency and water consumption. Simple maintenance with front access to consumables.
4. **PLC control / Control PLC** — Cabinets with touch HMI. Software integrated into the production line and safety system tailored for Industry 4.0. Real-time tracking of cycles, alarms and consumption, with remote support over the customer's network.

### T03 — Fluid treatment (Tratamiento de fluidos)

Coolant filtration, magnetic separation and fluid centralization. Oil recovery and responsible waste handling.

Bullets:

1. **Belt filters / Filtros de banda** — Gravity filtration with paper or textile cloth. Low operating cost, ideal for water-soluble coolants in machining. Automatic cloth advance driven by bath level and rewind of dry residue for simple disposal.
2. **Magnetic separators / Separadores magnéticos** — Drums and magnetic bars that remove fine ferrous particles before the main filter. Captures micrometric chips that would otherwise saturate the cloth. Extends consumable life.
3. **Advanced filtration / Filtración avanzada** — Pumping, pressurization and temperature-control stations for coolant feeding multiple machines in parallel. Centralized system that keeps flow and temperature stable regardless of individual demand. Pressure, conductivity and level monitoring with configurable alarms.
4. **Oil recovery / Recuperación de aceite** — Belt skimmers and coalescing separators that remove tramp oil from coolant so the fluid can be reused. Extends coolant life several times over and lowers waste-treatment cost.

### T04 — General metalwork (Metalúrgica general)

End-to-end metalworking services: high-precision laser and plasma cutting, CNC bending and serial parts production with fast turnaround.

Bullets:

1. **Laser cutting / Corte láser** — High-precision laser cutting services for industry, up to 12.7 mm (1/2 inch). Carbon steel, stainless steel and aluminum. Tight tolerances and clean edges ready for downstream welding or bending.
2. **Plasma cutting / Corte plasma** — Plasma cutting services for industry, up to 25.4 mm (1 inch). Especially efficient at thicknesses where laser stops being competitive.
3. **Industrial bending / Plegado industrial** — CNC press brake for bends up to 3 m. Programmed from 3D drawings, with a die library covering varied thicknesses and radii. High repeatability for serial production.
4. **Serial production / Producción en serie** — Industrial capacity, decades of experience and an extensive supplier network produce metalworking parts in batches with fast turnaround. From customer-validated prototypes to recurring production runs. Includes assembly, welding and surface treatments when required.

## Services beyond delivery

- **S01 Reparaciones / Repairs** — Diagnostics, spare parts and refurbishment of Trans-Fil and third-party equipment.
- **S02 Retrofitting** — Modernization of existing machines: PLC, automation, energy efficiency.
- **S03 Mantenimiento / Maintenance** — Preventive and predictive plans. Scheduled visits and ongoing remote support.
- **S04 Ingeniería a medida / Custom engineering** — Process study, layout, simulation and mechanical design from scratch.

## Process — how Trans-Fil delivers each unit

1. **Estudio de proceso / Process study** — Assess the production process and the specific need; design a custom solution.
2. **Ingeniería / Engineering** — Custom structural, mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and safety engineering.
3. **Fabricación / Manufacturing** — Full build in the Córdoba workshop. Traceable materials and dry-run testing before dispatch.
4. **Puesta en marcha / Commissioning** — On-site installation, parameter tuning and training for operations and maintenance staff.
5. **Soporte / Support** — Spare parts, technical assistance and continuous improvements. Trans-Fil machines from the '90s are still running.

## Production applications (where the equipment goes)

The four production processes Trans-Fil equips most often. Each is stated as the symptom a plant reports, the installation that answers it and the benefit it buys.

Diagnostic symptoms that point at contaminated fluid: coolant changed every few weeks and hauled away; tooling lasting less than it should; machines stopped to clear chips by hand; coolant that smells or irritates operators; surface finish drifting without a clear cause; pumps or spindles failing early. Two or more of these together indicate a hidden cost with an engineering fix rather than bad luck.

### A01 — Tube forming

Symptom: the lubricant loads up with metal fines and tramp oil; the degraded fluid lubricates worse, accelerates roll and die wear, marks the tube surface and drives scrap up.
Installation: centralized filtration + magnetic separation + oil recovery.
Benefit: protects forming tooling and multiplies fluid life. Covered in depth by the /conformado landing.

### A02 — Machining and turning

Symptom: chips build up and the fines recirculate in the coolant while way-lube contaminates it further — tool wear, damage to pumps and spindles, and stoppages to clean by hand.
Installation: centralized chip transport + belt filter + magnetic separator.
Benefit: longer tool life, fewer stoppages, clean coolant.

### A03 — Precision grinding

Symptom: fine abrasive swarf is nearly invisible but ruins the finish and wears the wheel if it isn't taken out of the fluid; tolerance drifts batch to batch.
Installation: fine filtration (belt or paper) + high-efficiency magnetic separation.
Benefit: stable finish, longer wheel life, clear coolant.

### A04 — Parts washing and prep

Symptom: parts reach assembly, welding or paint with oil and chips still on them; manual washing is inconsistent and becomes a bottleneck on the line.
Installation: industrial washer (pass-through, rotary or cabinet) with integrated filtration and PLC control.
Benefit: repeatable cleanliness, higher throughput, longer bath life.

### Typical results of the investment

Coolant life 2–4× with oil and fines removal · coolant-change frequency −50/70% · tool life +10/30% · lower liquid-waste disposal cost · fewer stoppages for manual chip cleanup. Typical ranges in installations with proper treatment; actual results depend on the process and are quantified in the on-site survey.

Every machine is sized against the real process — chip type, coolant, flow rate, layout and line cadence — and validated with a 3D design before fabrication.

## Application landings

Pages dedicated to one production application rather than to the company. Each one has its own FAQ, its own schema.org Service node and its own contact form; paid campaigns point at these, not at the home.

### Tube-forming lines (ERW / HFW / roll forming / drawing)

Centralized coolant filtration for tube mills. Three stages plus a central station: magnetic separation for ferrous fines, belt filtration for solids, belt skimmers / coalescing separators for tramp oil, and a pumping-pressurization-tempering station feeding the whole line. Sized from an on-site survey before quoting; built in the Córdoba workshop. Typical results with proper treatment: coolant life 2–4×, coolant-change frequency −50/70%, tool life +10/30%.
